title: Manage Add-ons
text:
## Manage Add-ons
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000057921
In this section, the admin can view all activated add-ons on the site, see details about each one, and find out how to get them individually if needed.
Go to Dashboard > Manage Add-Ons :
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12168212706/original/53Nj6vdF0LgPFxSAR1HvgelhDQvLAhP2oQ.png?1759160048 | alt: ]

## Add-On Status
The admin can filter the results:
Active
Inactive
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12168213259/original/xr2wzsmLBz4B8-ztCYsWB3jKhn6q-N0MMA.png?1759160440 | alt: ]

## Add-Ons Search
Or search for a specific add-on:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12168213299/original/-k0PaEk9n-Ly03BLR9srn_fY61OfwoqLIA.png?1759160487 | alt: ]

## Add-Ons Documentation
There is also a link to the documentation about the add-on:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12168213338/original/3a2kz9y8IP3h7OimIrqT6lqdAHHo8fU9tA.png?1759160539 | alt: ]

## Activating Add-Ons
Already purchased Add-Ons will be available to activate in the Account Dashboard. A ny purchased Add-Ons still pending activation will be listed in this section.
The " Click to Activate + " button to assign the add-on package to one of the available Website Licenses.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12123337109/original/4B1MKtW7LBCe5qAe4lqDPra9eAMlftIzvQ.png?1680119884 | alt: ]
